summary.text: Siela A. Bynoe is a Democratic state senator from New York who has represented District 6 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Siela Bynoe assumed office in the New York State Senate on January 1, 2025, succeeding Kevin Thomas, after defeating Republican Thomas Philip Montefinise in the November 2024 general election for District 6.

Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Education, Transportation, Mental Health, Consumer Protection, Environmental Conservation, and Investigations and Government Operations, and as chair of the Libraries Committee.
In the 2026 general election she faces Matthew Capp, who is running on the Republican and Conservative Party lines.
